forecastActuals.workingCapitalBasis: Arithmetic mean of five consecutive annual change-in-NWC/revenue ratios. Change in NWC = negative FMP cash-flow changeInWorkingCapital (includes other operating working capital); positive increases consume cash. Not a difference of only receivables, inventories and payables.

revenueProvenance.comparabilityBasis: Groups preserve actual scope and accounting transitions, not reporting years. FY2010/H12009/H12010 share continuing-operation revenue with total-operation earnings and do not bridge automatically to the post-disposal 2011-onward scope. The 2011-2015 group is before control of Melco Crown; the 2016-2017 group consolidates it from the actual 2016 control-acquisition date, not pro forma for earlier months. FY2016 minus H12016 therefore leaves the fully controlled second half, compatible with H12017; the 2015-to-2016 control transition remains blocked. melco-2018-interim/pages46-47 explicitly adopts HKFRS15 prospectively by the modified retrospective method: 2017 is not adjusted and promoter commissions move into revenue deductions, so 2018 is a separate basis. IFRS16 and represented reported operating lines from 2019 define the common current group. melco-2023-annual/pages105-106 presents 2023/2022 consistently across the concession renewal; actual concession costs are retained, not pro forma. FY2025 in melco-2025-annual/pages120-121 and H12025/H12026 in melco-2026-interim/pages31-32 support current TTM arithmetic. Operating income/EBITDA before 2019 remains unavailable independently of grouping. EPS is not additive.
revenueProvenance.basis: Actual consolidated statutory revenue/net revenues, without mechanically adding gaming tax or replacing the statement with a provider's net-of-tax approximation. FY2025 is HKD40,240,892 thousand. Revenue before 2016 reflects the actual then-consolidated group: the equity-accounted casino associate's turnover is not grossed up into group revenue. Consolidation changes, disposal gains and published comparative presentations are retained.
revenueProvenance.depreciationAndAmortizationBasis: Before 2016, the published expense is PPE depreciation; the reviewed annual intangible-asset notes identify club memberships/debentures with indefinite lives, not a missing amortisation charge. FY2010/H12009/H12010 D&A and financing charges include both continuing and discontinued operations. FY2010 pretax profit is the all-operation amount explicitly disclosed in the cash-flow reconciliation; H12009/H12010 all-operation pretax profit/tax are derived from the continuing face statement plus the complete discontinued-operation note, including disposal loss.
revenueProvenance.limitations: No reported operating subtotal for FY2010–18/H12009–18: operatingIncome is deliberately null, not pretax profit plus finance costs (which would contaminate operating profit with associate/disposal/investment results). Thus core EBITDA is unavailable for those periods despite reviewed D&A. FY2010/H12009/H12010 retain the issuer's continuing-operation revenue presentation but total-operation pretax/tax/D&A/finance charges and owner net earnings/EPS, with the complete discontinued results explicitly reviewed rather than mixing tax/pretax scopes. H12009 pretax derivation is -815234 +6277 -1804 = -810761 and total tax is602; H12010 pretax is -207333 -10646 = -217979 and total tax is0. FY2010 interest income remains null because only continuing-operation interest19381 is separately identified and the disposed business's other-income635 is not disaggregated. H12009–14 total interest income remains null: associate-interest subsets or rounded MD&A figures do not establish the exact consolidated total. H12015/16 interest income follows the explicitly disclosed bank-interest credit, not an asserted total of undisclosed financing yields. FY2016/17 interest includes both bank deposits and structured notes, explicitly reconciled to61423/36865. Pre-2019 interestExpense denotes reported finance costs, not cash coupon interest; 2019 onward uses separately reported interest expense net of amounts capitalised. Published EPS restatements/rounding retained: FY2024 and H12024 both use their explicitly restated 2025-report comparatives. Neither casino-associate revenue nor pre-acquisition subsidiary history is invented.
